FINAL IVX PENDING-ITEM EXECUTION
RESUME FROM THE CURRENT LEDGER — DO NOT RESTART COMPLETED PHASES

EXECUTE THE REMAINING ITEMS IN THE EXACT ORDER BELOW.

Do not repeat the 400-item audit.
Do not re-test completed items unless a new deployment affects them.
Do not return another planning report.
Do not stop after describing a blocker.
Use existing owner-controlled credentials and variables first.
Only request owner action when a real check proves the required credential,
approval, physical device, or external infrastructure is unavailable.

CURRENT VERIFIED COMPLETED ITEMS

- Fresh real bug-fix certification: COMPLETED
- QA-only certification: COMPLETED
- Autonomous revision loop: COMPLETED
- Investor Performance Center module: CREATED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE
- GitHub HEAD equals Render runtime SHA
- Registration end-to-end API flow: PASS
- No critical Rork runtime dependency
- Current automated test suite: PASS

DO NOT REPEAT THESE ITEMS.

==================================================
EXECUTION RULE
==================================================

Work continuously through every remaining phase.

For each phase:

1. Create or reuse one task ID.
2. Record starting status.
3. Execute the work.
4. Fix failures.
5. Re-run the failed test.
6. Commit only related changes.
7. Deploy when required.
8. Verify live.
9. Update the existing proof ledger.
10. Continue immediately to the next phase.

Only pause for an exact owner approval phrase or a physical owner action.

When approval is required, return only:

ITEM:
CURRENT STATUS:
ACTION READY:
EXACT APPROVAL PHRASE:
WHAT WILL EXECUTE AFTER APPROVAL:

After approval, resume from that exact item. Do not start a new audit.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — CREATE THE INDEPENDENT APP
CLOSE ITEMS 206–245
==================================================

APPLICATION NAME:
IVX Property Inspection

This must be a separate owner-controlled application, not a disconnected
sample folder and not a fake generated scaffold.

--------------------------------------------------
1.1 VERIFY EXISTING OWNER VARIABLES
--------------------------------------------------

Before requesting anything, verify whether these already exist:

- GITHUB_TOKEN
- GitHub owner/account
- Supabase Management API token
- Supabase organization ID
- Render API key
- AWS/S3 credentials if used for APK distribution
- AI provider key
- Expo/EAS credentials if available

Return only variable names and status:

AVAILABLE
MISSING
INVALID
EXPIRED
REVOKED
HTTP_401
HTTP_403

Never expose secret values.

Do not ask the owner for a credential unless its verification produces
MISSING, 401, 403, expired, deleted, or revoked.

--------------------------------------------------
1.2 OWNER APPROVAL FOR REPOSITORY CREATION
--------------------------------------------------

Prepare creation of a new repository under the owner GitHub account.

Proposed repository:

ibb142/ivx-property-inspection

If the name already exists, inspect it before creating another repository.

Required approval phrase:

CONFIRM_IVX_CREATE_REPOSITORY

After approval:

1. Create repository.
2. Set owner as repository owner.
3. Set main as default branch.
4. Add branch protection where supported.
5. Create initial commit.
6. Return repository URL and commit SHA.

--------------------------------------------------
1.3 GENERATE THE REAL APPLICATION
--------------------------------------------------

Required application structure:

apps/mobile
apps/web
backend
shared
supabase/migrations
docs
.github/workflows

Required technology:

- Expo Router
- React Native
- TypeScript
- Supabase
- owner-controlled backend
- official IVX design tokens
- official IVX logo
- no Rork SDK
- no Rork proxy
- no Rork URL
- no Rork package name
- no placeholder branding

Required mobile features:

1. Sign in
2. Owner/admin authorization
3. Inspector authorization
4. Inspector profile
5. Property list
6. Property details
7. Create inspection
8. Inspection status
9. Room checklist
10. Inspection items
11. Notes
12. Photo upload
13. Condition rating
14. Issue severity
15. Offline draft
16. Resume draft
17. Reconnect synchronization
18. Submit inspection
19. Inspection summary
20. Health/version screen
21. Logout
22. Session persistence
23. Loading states
24. Empty states
25. Error boundaries

Required web features:

- owner login
- inspection list
- inspection details
- photo review
- issue filtering
- inspection status
- inspector assignment
- summary export
- responsive layout
- role authorization

--------------------------------------------------
1.4 CREATE THE DATABASE
--------------------------------------------------

Use an isolated owner-controlled Supabase project or approved isolated schema.

Required tables:

- profiles
- properties
- inspections
- inspection_rooms
- inspection_items
- inspection_photos
- inspection_issues

Required database controls:

- UUID primary keys
- created_at
- updated_at
- foreign keys
- unique constraints
- indexes
- owner policies
- inspector policies
- row-level security
- storage policies
- duplicate-submission prevention
- migration rollback

Required approval before production database execution:

CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION

Do not execute a production migration without approval.

After execution return:

SUPABASE_PROJECT:
MIGRATION_FILES:
TABLES_CREATED:
INDEXES:
FOREIGN_KEYS:
RLS_POLICIES:
ROLLBACK_TEST:
DATA_INTEGRITY_RESULT:

--------------------------------------------------
1.5 TEST THE NEW APP
--------------------------------------------------

Run:

- clean dependency install
- unit tests
- integration tests
- API contract tests
- authentication tests
- authorization tests
- offline-draft tests
- reconnect tests
- upload tests
- duplicate-submission tests
- TypeScript
- lint
- security scan
- secret scan
- no-Rork scan

Required:

- zero critical failures
- zero TypeScript errors
- zero lint errors in changed files
- no service-role key in client code

--------------------------------------------------
1.6 COMMIT AND DEPLOY
--------------------------------------------------

Request GitHub approval:

CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE

Request backend/web deployment approval:

CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY

After approval:

1. Commit the app.
2. Deploy backend.
3. Deploy web portal.
4. Verify HTTPS.
5. Call health endpoint.
6. Verify runtime SHA.
7. Verify login.
8. Open inspection list.
9. Create a test inspection.
10. Verify production database record.

Required evidence:

TASK_ID:
REPOSITORY:
BRANCH:
COMMIT_SHA:
RENDER_DEPLOY_ID:
RUNTIME_SHA:
WEB_URL:
HEALTH_RESULT:
SUPABASE_PROJECT:
TEST_INSPECTION_ID:
RORK_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCIES:

--------------------------------------------------
1.7 BUILD THE INDEPENDENT APP APK
--------------------------------------------------

Create a production Android APK.

Required:

- unique package name
- correct IVX icon
- correct splash
- signed APK
- production environment
- no Expo Go dependency
- no Rork dependency
- JavaScript bundling 100%
- Android compilation successful

Return:

APK_FILENAME:
VERSION:
VERSION_CODE:
PACKAGE_NAME:
FILE_SIZE:
SHA256:
SOURCE_COMMIT:
BUILD_RESULT:

Request upload approval:

CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD

After approval:

- upload APK
- verify HTTP 200
- verify Content-Length
- verify ETag
- verify SHA-256
- return direct URL

PHASE 1 IS COMPLETE ONLY WHEN THE NEW REPOSITORY, DATABASE, WEB PORTAL,
BACKEND, AND APK ALL EXIST AND ARE VERIFIED.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — FINISH THE CURRENT IVX APK
CLOSE ITEMS 246–270
==================================================

Current source version:
1.4.36

Current required versionCode:
68 or the next unused value

Current live APK:
1.4.35

The live APK is outdated.

--------------------------------------------------
2.1 VERIFY MOBILE CHANGES
--------------------------------------------------

Confirm the current commit contains:

- QueryClient improvements
- DealVideoCard using expo-image
- HoldingCard using expo-image
- TrustDealCard using expo-image
- Home skeleton loading
- CRM skeleton loading
- Invest hardcoded colors = 0
- Profit/Loss hardcoded colors = 0
- IVX IA Chat branding
- business/document branding
- App Factory branding inheritance
- correct IVX logo
- correct version
- correct versionCode

Do not rewrite these features unless verification fails.

--------------------------------------------------
2.2 FIX THE BUILD ENVIRONMENT
--------------------------------------------------

The previous build was interrupted by Watchman/system limitations.

Do not run the same failing method repeatedly.

Execute:

1. Disable Watchman for the build process.
2. Clear Metro temporary cache.
3. Clear Expo cache.
4. Clear Gradle build cache only when necessary.
5. Remove stale bundle output.
6. Run clean dependency installation.
7. Verify package-lock/bun.lock consistency.
8. Run Expo export or Android bundling independently.
9. Confirm JavaScript bundle reaches 100%.
10. Run Gradle assembleRelease.
11. Capture full build log.
12. If the sandbox interrupts again, use the configured owner-controlled
    Render build runner, GitHub Actions runner, Expo EAS, or another
    non-Rork build host.

Do not mark BLOCKED until every configured owner-controlled build runner
has been tested.

Required build commands must be returned exactly.

--------------------------------------------------
2.3 PRODUCE THE APK
--------------------------------------------------

Required artifact:

ivx-holdings-v1.4.36.apk

Use the actual final version if a newer version is necessary.

Return:

APK_FILENAME:
VERSION:
VERSION_CODE:
PACKAGE:
BUILD_HOST:
BUILD_COMMAND:
BUILD_DURATION:
FILE_SIZE:
SHA256:
SOURCE_COMMIT:
JS_BUNDLE_PERCENT:
ANDROID_COMPILE_RESULT:

--------------------------------------------------
2.4 UPLOAD THE APK
--------------------------------------------------

Request:

CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD

After approval:

1. Upload to the owner-controlled IVX APK path.
2. Verify HTTP 200.
3. Verify file size.
4. Verify ETag.
5. Download the uploaded APK.
6. Verify downloaded SHA-256 equals local SHA-256.
7. Confirm the URL does not return the old v1.4.35 file.

Required final URL format:

https://ivxholding.com/apk/<actual-apk-filename>

--------------------------------------------------
2.5 PHYSICAL INSTALLATION HANDOFF
--------------------------------------------------

When the APK is ready, return one concise owner action:

1. Download the new APK.
2. Install it on Android.
3. Open Settings → About.
4. Capture version/versionCode.
5. Open Home, Invest, CRM, Reels and IVX IA Chat.
6. Upload the screenshots here.

Do not claim physical installation was completed unless device evidence exists.

==================================================
PHASE 3 — SMTP, EMAIL VERIFICATION AND RECOVERY
CLOSE ITEMS 271–300
==================================================

--------------------------------------------------
3.1 CHECK EXISTING SMTP CONFIGURATION
--------------------------------------------------

Check the existing Supabase authentication configuration and stored variables.

Required fields:

- SMTP host
- SMTP port
- SMTP user
- SMTP password binding
- sender email
- sender name
- sender domain
- TLS mode

Do not request credentials before checking stored variables.

If the fields are available, configure them automatically after approval.

If missing, return exactly:

MISSING:
SMTP_HOST
SMTP_PORT
SMTP_USER
SMTP_PASSWORD
SMTP_SENDER_EMAIL
SMTP_SENDER_NAME

Also state the exact DNS records required:

- SPF
- DKIM
- DMARC

Do not expose secret values.

--------------------------------------------------
3.2 CONFIGURE SMTP
--------------------------------------------------

Recommended provider:
Resend, Amazon SES, SendGrid, or an already approved provider.

Configure:

- verified sender domain
- sender identity
- SPF
- DKIM
- DMARC
- Supabase Auth SMTP settings
- production redirect URLs
- rate limits
- email templates with IVX branding

Required email templates:

- account confirmation
- resend confirmation
- password reset
- email change
- login/security notification if supported

--------------------------------------------------
3.3 LIVE EMAIL TESTS
--------------------------------------------------

Run with a real controlled email account:

1. Register new account.
2. Verify confirmation email delivered.
3. Open confirmation link.
4. Verify account is confirmed.
5. Request resend.
6. Verify resend email.
7. Request password reset.
8. Verify reset email delivered.
9. Open reset link.
10. Change password.
11. Verify new password succeeds.
12. Verify old password fails.
13. Verify reused reset link fails.
14. Verify expired link fails.
15. Verify no account enumeration.
16. Verify rate limiting.
17. Verify no credentials appear in logs.

Return:

SMTP_PROVIDER:
SPF:
DKIM:
DMARC:
CONFIRMATION_DELIVERED:
RESET_DELIVERED:
RESEND_DELIVERED:
NEW_PASSWORD:
OLD_PASSWORD_REJECTED:
REUSED_LINK_REJECTED:
RATE_LIMIT:
TRACE_IDS:

==================================================
PHASE 4 — PHYSICAL DEVICE AUTHENTICATION QA
CLOSE ITEMS 294–300 AND 301–325
==================================================

This phase requires the new IVX APK.

Do not run it on v1.4.35.

Required Android scenarios:

1. Clean install
2. Correct owner login
3. Invalid owner password
4. Correct member login
5. Invalid member password
6. Logout
7. Login again
8. Close app
9. Reopen app
10. Session persists
11. Token refresh
12. Network off
13. Network on
14. Background
15. Foreground
16. App restart
17. Password reset
18. Email confirmation
19. Member blocked from owner routes
20. MFA optional and OFF by default

Required browser matrix:

- Samsung Browser
- Android Chrome
- iPhone Safari when available
- Desktop Chrome
- Desktop Safari when available

For unavailable platforms use NOT_RUN, not PASS.

Return a test matrix:

PLATFORM
SCENARIO
RESULT
TIMESTAMP
SCREENSHOT
TRACE_ID

==================================================
PHASE 5 — PHYSICAL REELS SOAK TEST
CLOSE ITEMS 301–325
==================================================

Use the new APK on a real Android device.

Required:

- 60 minutes continuous use
- 500 reel transitions
- 200 viewer open/close cycles
- 100 background/foreground cycles
- network off/on tests
- Wi-Fi/cellular transitions where possible
- rapid swipe
- reverse swipe
- pause/resume
- mute/unmute
- comments sheet open/close
- app restart and return to Reels

Measure using Android Studio Profiler or equivalent:

- crashes
- ANRs
- peak memory
- final memory
- memory growth
- CPU
- FPS
- JS-thread stalls
- native-thread stalls
- active player count
- frozen frames
- black frames
- duplicated videos
- reconnect recovery time

Acceptance:

- zero crash
- zero ANR
- no indefinite memory growth
- bounded active players
- zero duplicated videos
- zero frozen players
- no endless loading
- successful reconnect recovery

Do not replace physical evidence with code-level tests.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — RATE LIMIT AND CLOUD LOAD TEST
CLOSE ITEMS 326–345
==================================================

--------------------------------------------------
6.1 RATE LIMITS
--------------------------------------------------

Test:

- login
- member registration
- forgot password
- IVX IA Chat
- uploads
- owner APIs
- expensive reporting APIs

Verify:

- HTTP 429
- Retry-After
- per-IP limit
- per-user limit where applicable
- no accidental system-wide lockout

--------------------------------------------------
6.2 CLOUD LOAD TEST
--------------------------------------------------

Use an owner-controlled cloud VM or load-testing service.

Run progressively:

1. 100 concurrent users
2. 500 concurrent users
3. 1,000 concurrent users
4. 5,000 concurrent users
5. 10,000 concurrent users only if previous stages are safe

Measure:

- p50
- p95
- p99
- throughput
- error rate
- timeouts
- Render CPU
- Render memory
- database connections
- database latency
- recovery after load

Endpoints:

- /health
- landing config
- featured properties
- home feed
- Reels feed
- deal details
- safe login test
- registration health

Do not run destructive registration storms against real users.

Stop at the first unsafe threshold and return the exact limiting resource.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — LIVE ROLLBACK DRILL
CLOSE ITEMS 346–355
==================================================

Prepare a safe visible non-destructive change.

Required sequence:

1. Record current healthy SHA.
2. Create a safe visible test change.
3. Add test.
4. Commit after approval.
5. Deploy after approval.
6. Verify visible change live.
7. Request rollback approval.
8. Roll back to previous healthy SHA.
9. Verify previous behavior restored.
10. Re-deploy final healthy version.
11. Verify final runtime SHA.
12. Save rollback proof.

Required approval:

CONFIRM_IVX_ROLLBACK

Return:

STARTING_SHA:
TEST_SHA:
TEST_DEPLOY_ID:
ROLLBACK_TARGET:
ROLLBACK_DEPLOY_ID:
RESTORE_DEPLOY_ID:
FINAL_SHA:
HEALTH:
LIVE_BEHAVIOR:
AUDIT_RECORD:

Unit tests do not replace the live rollback drill.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — FINAL MODULE AND PRODUCTION CERTIFICATION
==================================================

After Phases 1–7 complete, re-run only the final affected checks.

Verify:

1. Existing IVX production app healthy.
2. Investor Performance Center still live.
3. Independent Property Inspection app live.
4. Current IVX APK is the new version.
5. APK source SHA is recorded.
6. GitHub HEAD equals Render runtime SHA.
7. SMTP live.
8. Confirmation email live.
9. Password reset live.
10. Session persistence verified on device.
11. Reels soak test passed.
12. Rate limiting verified.
13. Load-test capacity recorded.
14. Rollback drill passed.
15. No Rork runtime dependency.
16. Proof ledger contains every final record.
